canonical_project: AM Green Greater Noida AI infrastructure campus (YEIDA region)
notes: UP government signed an MoU with AM Green for a ~1 GW green AI data centre (phased rollout, first capacity operational by 2028, full 1 GW by 2030) in the Greater Noida / YEIDA region; first-round codex lead cited ~289-acre AI infrastructure hub (~$25bn ambition). No land allotment or construction evidence yet; treat as announced MoU (B for event, C for site/capacity).
